hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(printf '%s' "$c" | head -c 120)" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/bash-guard.log"; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(]|[[:space:]])(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(pkill|killall|kill)([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'Blocked: stop a run with TaskStop and its task id, not kill/pkill/killall. A pattern match can hit a process that is not yours; a task id is exact. If TaskStop cannot reach the thing you want to stop, the mistake was upstream -- you chained several runs into one background task. Launch one task per run instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) python3 "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/tools/gen_filemap.py" >/dev/null || true;; esac; }
